name: Quantum ESPRESSO
summary: An open-source suite for electronic-structure calculations; this Hub bundle models the pinned PWscf regression inputs.
scope: Reusable DIPL schemas and native pw.x generation for all 27 inputs in the pinned test-suite/pw_scf directory: SCF, NSCF, and bands cases.
validation_qualifier: On 2026-10-09, all 27 generated inputs matched their pinned PWscf regression references under a semantic comparison; 34 project tests passed. Two complete setups stage checked pseudopotentials. No solver execution or scientific-result validation is claimed.
limitations: The scope is the 27 pinned PWscf regression inputs, not all pw.x features or other QE executables. Twenty-five recipes need pseudopotentials or preceding workflow state and are native-inputs-only. This independent adapter has no QE maintainer endorsement; input parity does not establish a successful build or physical result.
